lessons.title: Practice Token Store
lessons.description: Implement TokenStore with set/get/clear methods. The test checks that TokenStore().get() equals 't'; TokenStore().get() is None.
learning_objectives: Mesa clerks recount crates before dawn, and store auth tokens client-side.

tests.name: test_token_store
tests.unittest_code:
def test_token_store(self):
    s = TokenStore()
    self.assertIsNone(s.get())
    s.set('t')
    self.assertEqual(s.get(), 't')
    s.clear()
    self.assertIsNone(s.get())

lessons.title: Decode JWT Payload
lessons.description: Implement jwt_payload(token) decoding the middle base64url segment as JSON. The test checks that jwt_payload(token) equals {'sub': '1'}.
learning_objectives: Orchard clerks recount crates before dawn, and decode JWT payloads without verifying.
lessons.starter_code:
import base64, json

def jwt_payload(token):
    # TODO
    pass
lessons.solution_code:
import base64, json

def jwt_payload(token):
    parts = token.split('.')
    payload = parts[1]
    pad = '=' * (-len(payload) % 4)
    raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload + pad)
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))

tests.name: test_jwt_payload
tests.unittest_code:
def test_jwt_payload(self):
    import base64, json
    payload = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({'sub': '1'}).encode()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
    token = 'x.' + payload + '.y'
    self.assertEqual(jwt_payload(token), {'sub': '1'})

source.name: FastAPI docs — OAuth2 JWT — 'It is not encrypted, so, anyone could recover the information from the contents. But it's signed.'

lessons.title: Practice Expiry Check
lessons.description: Implement is_expired(payload, now) True if payload exp <= now. The test checks that is_expired({'exp': 10}, 10) is true; is_expired({'exp': 11}, 10) is false.
learning_objectives: Quarry clerks recount crates before dawn, and detect expired tokens.
lessons.solution_code:
def is_expired(payload, now):
    return payload.get('exp', 0) <= now

lessons.title: Practice Checkpoint Refresh Decision
lessons.description: Implement should_refresh(payload, now, skew=30) True if exp - now <= skew. The test checks that should_refresh({'exp': 100}, 80, skew=30) is true; should_refresh({'exp': 200}, 80, skew=30) is false.
learning_objectives: Attic clerks recount crates before dawn, and decide when to refresh tokens.
lessons.solution_code:
def should_refresh(payload, now, skew=30):
    return payload.get('exp', 0) - now <= skew

tests.name: test_should_refresh
